title: Negative information questions with plural action verbs
focus: With plural persons, the negative verb is emme, ette or eivät. Miksi te ette tule? — Koska olemme sairaita.
targetSkills: Negative information questions with plural action verbs
prerequisiteSkills: Negative information questions with singular action verbs

exercises.prompt: Choose the question meaning “Why aren't you coming?”  Address a group (te).
exercises.explanation: Plural means more than one in this grammatical pattern. With plural persons, the negative verb is emme, ette or eivät. The main verb's negative form does not take a plural personal ending: Miksi te ette tule? (“Why aren't you coming?” addressed to a group). The same negative stem serves every person. The complete question means “Why aren't you coming”.
requiredSkills: Negative information questions with plural action verbs
exercises.targetSkill: Negative information questions with plural action verbs
